question: Can upstream surface data constrain separate local first/last markers, and does causal two-site capture remove the initial-data inverse sensitivity before another nonlinear reception run?

method.action: Frozen linear neutral sector of unchanged SS OCF 1: M b_tt=-K b, both M and K Z-weighted. No nonlinear receiver.
method.domain: Frozen independently solved omega_Q=.9 profiles from verified transfer run; h=.05,.025,.0125, R=80; independent R100 at h=.025.
method.boundaries: Regular origin and outer Dirichlet; duration60, local r=.1, acquisition r14 to t16.
method.initial_data: Support[18,26], v=D_h b; broad and carrier prior shapes plus new center21.5 width2.75 carrier.8. All shapes fixed before execution. A=.012.
method.solver: RK4 dt=.0025 and finest .00125. Exact adjoint H and L; full economy SVD. Two-site causal commutator forcing from b and b_t every .0125, stopped at t16; sample .025 control.
method.tolerances: Separate first/last target1e-4, floor1e-7. eta=1e-10||surface||, rho=2||recovered input|| are explicit conditional perturbation radii. Causal timing budgets use residual mesh/time/domain changes and both output/surface sampling; absolute event mesh changes are reported separately.

hypotheses.prediction: Surface-consistent variations constrain both events to the declared target; causal capture gives controlled local markers.
Weak singular directions move late events despite tiny surface residual, or finite acquisition/sampling leaves causal timing unresolved.

controls.purpose: Separate each source of numerical error
controls.method: Three meshes, independent finest time halving, wider box, independent surface/output decimation.

controls.purpose: Test interior sensitivity rather than surface fit
controls.method: Retained/discarded decomposition, explicit input norm prior and surface tolerance, finite adversarial witnesses.
Two-site commutator source reconstructs projected interior state at16; omitted exterior state remains an audited error.

controls.purpose: Avoid judging only previously inspected shapes
controls.method: All methods locked on three linear shapes before their interior audits; new shape is only a linear validation, not held-out nonlinear reception.
